primitives.name: Dashboard Confidence Disclosure
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Dashboard confidence leak.** `/dashboard` queried today's picks with **no tier filter** and rendered the numeric confidence (`{pick.confidence}% conf` + a confidence bar) to every logged-in member.
primitives.assumptions: User tier is not enforced server-side during dashboard query; confidence is rendered regardless of entitlement.

layer2.mapping: Confidence rendering is isomorphic to entitlement resolution in GSI's belief update model where C is a derived variable based on T.
layer2.telemetry: Rendered confidence values without tier filtering

primitives.name: Picks API Tier Caching Inconsistency
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Paying members got the FREE view on /picks.** The picks page fetched its own `/api/picks` server-side without forwarding cookies and with `revalidate: 1800` — so the API always saw an anonymous viewer and the page served the cached FREE payload to everyone, including PRO/ELITE members.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P': 'picks payload (array of pick objects)', 'S': 'session cookie (boolean)', 'C': 'cache policy (integer seconds)', 'E': 'effective entitlement (FREE|PRO|ELITE)'}
primitives.assumptions: API response is cached without session context; caching bypasses entitlement checks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: E ≠ E_actual when S=false and C>0

layer2.mapping: Kernel of entitlement mismatch arises from cache invalidation logic failing to consider session state in GSE’s state transition graph.
layer2.telemetry: Mismatched entitlements in rendered picks vs actual user status

primitives.name: Dunning UX Invalidation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Dunning was a dead end.** `invoice.payment_action_required` (3D Secure) was ignored, and nothing anywhere told a PAST_DUE member their card needed attention — the `ManageSubscriptionButton` component existed but no page used it.
primitives.assumptions: Payment action required events are not surfaced to users; UI lacks feedback mechanism.

layer2.mapping: Dunning UX mirrors GSI's error propagation model where missing user feedback leads to persistent state misalignment.
layer2.telemetry: Absence of billing notices despite dunning webhook triggers

primitives.name: Ingestion Pipeline Behavioral Testing
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The 30-minute production heartbeat was untested.** `@sports/ingestion-pipeline` (processSport/settleSport — the single source of truth for pick generation and settlement) had no test script at all, so `npm test --workspaces` silently skipped it.
primitives.assumptions: Pipeline behavior is unverified under test conditions; testing framework skips uninstrumented workspaces.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of system reliability stems from test coverage gap in GSE's operational invariant validation.
layer2.telemetry: Skipped pipeline tests leading to undetected runtime anomalies

reasoning_traces.think:
The core issue across these primitives lies in the failure of tier-based access control to maintain consistency between client-side rendering and server-side entitlement evaluation. In the dashboard confidence leak, the absence of a tier filter allows all users to see confidence scores, violating the principle that only premium tiers should have access to such metrics. This is a direct violation of conditional probability models where confidence is a derived variable dependent on user type. The picks API caching flaw demonstrates how improper session handling leads to incorrect data delivery—this is a state transition problem in GSE where the system fails to correctly map session state to entitlements. The dunning UX failure highlights a communication breakdown in feedback loops, where payment-related events do not trigger appropriate UI responses, creating a disconnect between backend billing states and frontend user experience. Finally, the pipeline test floor reveals a systemic lack of verification mechanisms, which undermines trust in the foundational data flow. These failures collectively suggest a need for a unified, mathematically grounded access control layer that enforces entitlements at every interaction point, ensuring that data integrity and user experience remain aligned.
